newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bundesbank chief Tietmeyer cancels Thai trip.
newsitem.headline: Bundesbank chief Tietmeyer cancels Thai trip.

text.p: Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer has cancelled a visit to Thailand for family reasons, the German central bank said on Wednesday.
Tietmeyer had been scheduled to deliver an address on European economic and monetary union on Thursday during a meeting of 10 Asian central bank governors in Bangkok.
A Bundesbank official said Tietmeyer cancelled the trip due to sickness in his family.
Bundesbank Deputy President Johann Wilhelm Gaddum would attend the event, the Bundesbank said.

The central bank governors of Thailand, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, Sri Lanka, Nepal, Taiwan, Burma and South Korea will attend the 32nd SEACEN Governors Conference scheduled for February 13-16.
